# Shruti 1.4.1
This reliability update fixes app playback on multichannel audio interfaces and reduces the Core Audio work Shruti performs during streaming and video playback.
## Fixed
- Spotify, Chrome, YouTube and other app audio no longer go silent when Shruti engages on a device whose hardware-input buffers appear before the app's stereo process tap. - Capture-only apps such as camera utilities no longer keep an output aggregate alive. - A camera or call app whose Core Audio output flag remains stuck on after proven silence stays on the direct path until a real playback stop/start transition. - Short browser-helper and player-state changes no longer churn otherwise healthy tap helpers.
## Performance
- The audio callback now reuses its buffer and performs no steady-state heap allocation. - Wall-clock activity sampling moved out of the real-time callback and onto the existing worker heartbeat. - The menu UI refreshes once per second while visible and every three seconds while hidden, instead of rebuilding the full app and device snapshot twice per second at all times.
Shruti remains direct by default: an app receives a private, isolated helper only while one of its saved controls is engaged and macOS reports real playback.
